# Teamwide AI

> We help businesses implement AI to cut costs and increase profits. We tell you where AI fits, where it does not, and how to put it in. Free AI Audit.

## Guides

- [Job Costing for Contractors: Spot Losing Jobs](https://teamwideai.com/guides/job-costing-for-contractors/): Pull two exports into one sheet and run this AI prompt on the 1st of every month. It flags every job under your margin and lists unbilled change orders.
- [Overdue Invoice Reminder: 3 Messages to Copy](https://teamwideai.com/guides/overdue-invoice-reminders/): Copy the AI rules for day 7 and day 21 overdue invoice reminders with your pay link, plus a day 35 call list. Never a threat. You check every note.
- [Missed Call Text Back and Emergency Rule](https://teamwideai.com/guides/missed-call-text-back/): Set up missed call text back in Quo, Grasshopper, Jobber, or Housecall Pro. Then let AI read every reply and flag real emergencies to your phone.
- [AI for HVAC Companies: 7 Setups to Copy](https://teamwideai.com/guides/ai-for-hvac/): 7 AI setups for HVAC companies: after hours calls, open estimates, old systems, reviews, and a 6am text. For Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan.
- [How to Get ChatGPT to Recommend Your Business](https://teamwideai.com/guides/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): Check who ChatGPT names in your trade and town and see which sites it read. Then copy the 3 weekly habits that give AI real facts about your business.
- [Quote Follow Up Email and Text Rules](https://teamwideai.com/guides/quote-follow-up/): AI rules that write a short quote follow up email or text about each job on day 2, 7, and 21. Works with Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan.
- [AI for Roofing Companies: 7 Setups to Copy](https://teamwideai.com/guides/ai-for-roofing/): 7 AI setups for roofing companies: open quotes, missed calls, storm and hail mode, job pages, reviews, neighbor postcards, and insurance summaries.
- [Employee Called in Sick: The 6am Crew Setup](https://teamwideai.com/guides/employee-called-in-sick/): How to cover a sick call out before you wake up. Get the crew sheet, the six rules, the three texts, and the AI prompt to fill the open shift.

## Agents

- [Review helper: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/review-helper/): Drafts a review request after every job and a reply to every new review.
- [Missed call catcher: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/missed-call-catcher/): Logs every missed call and drafts a text back.
- [Quote drafter: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/quote-drafter/): Turns a short note into a clean draft quote.
- [Quote follow up: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/quote-follow-up/): Keeps track of every open quote and drafts the next follow up.
- [DM sales agent: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/dm-sales-agent/): Reads every DM, asks the right questions and gets ready buyers to book a call.
- [Invoice chaser: AI agent](https://teamwideai.com/agents/invoice-chaser/): Tracks overdue invoices and drafts a polite nudge.
